text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswanan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A decision on whether to give Zambia access to the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) could be made within two months.
Zambia recently threatened to put restrictve tariffs on South African goods unless it was allowed more access to the South African market.
- Botswana was voted the third most favourable tourist destination in southern Africa, at a recent travel fair held in South Africa.

- Four wildlife experts drawn from South Africa, the U.K, France and Botswana, are evaluating Botswana's proposal that elephants be removed from Appendix I of the Conventionon International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES).
- The Botswana Defence Force has confirmed it has found a willing seller to provide it with tanks, after the Germans blocked a deal two months ago for Botswana to buy German-made tanks from Holland.
